## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector performance with strong tech semiconductors but weak communication and healthcare 1W returns, and major divergence across large caps (several megacaps showing 1W ≠ 1M), supporting a restrained, neutral stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leading: SLB (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +8.21%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -8.79%) RECOVERY. Technology leading: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing shallow leadership: WMT (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +5.57%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication lagging: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND and wider sector weakness. Healthcare lagging: DHR (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND. Industrials lagging: LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND, RTX (1W: -11.28% | 1M: -10.64%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, NUE (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +30.18%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: COF (1W: -7.30% | 1M: +3.33%) CORRECTION, IBM (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -3.90%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -5.59%) BELOW TREND, DHR (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -9.76% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select tech and industrial names and reflects short-term rotation.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present across megacaps (e.g., META, JPM, MA showing 1W ≠ 1M) — treat momentum moves as tactical until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech: 14/24 positive (mixed internals). Semiconductors leading with AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND and TXN (1W: +20.59% | 1M: +40.84%) ABOVE TREND, while IBM (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -3.90%) BELOW TREND and ACN (1W: -9.76% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND show cracks.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials: 6/20 positive (internally mixed). COF (1W: -7.30% | 1M: +3.33%) CORRECTION, JPM (1W: -0.65% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION and V (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +1.48%) CORRECTION point to short-term hesitation despite some 1M strength.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare: 5/17 positive (sector weakness). UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND is the clear outlier while DHR (1W: -8.99% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -5.18%) BELOW TREND show broad pressure.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Given NEUTRAL regime and concentrated tech leadership, favor exposure to leading semiconductors and select cyclicals (AMD, INTC, CAT) while reducing exposure to names showing exhaustion (CHTR, TMO, ACN). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; monitor megacap divergences before adding beta.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND — watch earnings/sentiment flow for follow-through. BEARISH: CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -17.74%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum could continue.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (semiconductor group leadership; Tech: 14/24 positive) and Energy (SLB ABOVE TREND) for follow-through. BEARISH: Communication (CHTR BELOW TREND) and Healthcare (UNH lone leader; Healthcare: 5/17 positive) for continued dispersion.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch for follow-through above recent breakout levels in AMD and INTC as confirmation of the semiconductor rally; NVDA (1W: +3.27% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND holding 1M uptrend would validate broader AI leadership. Monitor CHTR failing to reclaim its 1M range as a trigger for further risk reduction and UNH holding its 1W gains as a healthcare sentiment confirmation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTC (+80): Intel Q1 beat — price confirming with INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. UNH (+60): Q1 beat/guidance lift — UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. AMD (+55): upgrade/upgrade flow — AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. GOOGL (+55): strategic AI investment headlines — GOOGL (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +18.38%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment supportive but watch execution.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
CHTR (-50): subscriber concerns — CHTR (1W: -23.87% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed and at risk. FCX (-50): downgrade concerns — FCX (1W: -13.05% | 1M: +7.17%) CORRECTION; bearish headlines diverge from 1M strength, watch for follow-through or distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +24.94% | 1M: +57.90%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +20.50% | 1M: +74.95%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergences among megacaps and negative sentiment around CHTR/selected healthcare names — monitor for confirmation before expanding exposure.
